about.title: About AGRO-MARKS
about.intro: AGRO-MARKS is an agricultural marketplace project that aims to bring Cameroonian consumers closer to the women and men who produce their food.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To make farmers, their farms and their working methods visible, so that everyone can choose produce knowing where it comes from.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Present practices as described by the growers, without unsupported promises.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.text: Shorten the distance between field and table, region by region.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Highlight the know-how, sorting and care that go into each harvest.

nature.title: Respect for nature
nature.text: Celebrate crop diversity and the rhythm of the seasons.

status.title: Where is the project today?
status.text: This site is a demo version. Growers, prices and testimonials are fictional. Next steps include onboarding real farms, a process for verifying information and, eventually, features to put buyers and growers in touch.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about AGRO-MARKS and this demo version.

what.question: What is AGRO-MARKS?
what.answer: AGRO-MARKS is an agricultural marketplace project that presents Cameroonian farmers, their farms, their production methods and their produce.

order.question: Can I order or pay online?
order.answer: No. This version is a demo: no ordering, payment or delivery is offered.

prices.question: Are the prices shown real?
prices.answer: No. Prices are indicative and fictional. They are shown in CFA francs (FCFA) to illustrate how the catalogue works.

farmers.question: Do the farmers shown really exist?
farmers.answer: The farms and people shown are fictional. They are inspired by crops that are genuinely grown in Cameroon's regions.

certification.question: Are the farming practices certified?
certification.answer: No. The practices described are presented as reported by the growers. No certification or label is claimed in this version.

favorites.question: How do favourites work?
favorites.answer: Favourites are saved in your browser's local storage. They are not linked to an account and disappear if you clear the site's data.

join.question: I am a farmer. How can I join the platform?
join.answer: Grower registration is not open yet. You can express your interest through the contact page; note that messages are not transmitted yet in this version.

languages.question: Which languages is the site available in?
languages.answer: The site is available in French and English. Use the language selector in the header to switch between them.
